name: Jones

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a long curving paved driveway that leads from the street toward the front and side of the house and offers space for vehicle turnaround. The large rectangular swimming pool, adjacent hot tub, and fenced tennis court create multiple open hardscape and lawn areas that could support vehicle movement or staging. Extensive green lawn surrounds much of the house and provides open space on multiple sides. Mature trees are present around the property and may limit visibility in some areas, particularly along the driveway and near the house. Scattered construction materials and equipment are visible in several areas and may affect clear movement near the house and pool.
clarifications: Is the curving driveway a through route that continues around the house, or does it end at the main parking and turnaround area? Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the property or the driveway? Is vehicle access available all the way to the rear of the house near the pool and tennis court? What is the current status and purpose of the construction materials and equipment visible on the property? Are there any additional access points or pathways not visible in the available imagery?
